svg.aria-label: mvane yard on the FM-1: what each control does, the knob pages and the layers
svg.text: coral: a layer button (hold it and turn, or tap to open, tap to close)
teal: HOME, the knobs' page; lit on SOUND
NOTES: notes, each on its own MPE channel with its own pressure.
CHORDS: the scale's degrees, climbing the keyboard; higher keys, higher voicings.
Pressure: F3 to C5, each key its own (how hard, not where); the top row, C#5 to G5, has velocity only.
In CHORDS the chord key's pressure moves every voice (channel 1).
CHORDS: the chord's quality, latched (shown: the qualities bank; EDIT's BANK: types from the scale).
Several pressed together combine (M7 + S4); the only latched one tapped again: single notes. NOTES: notes.
F#5 is HOLD: a chord keeps sounding after you let go; the next white key changes it.
HOME switches them (lit: SOUND). Every turn on them is recorded with what you play.
Layers: hold a button and turn, or tap it to open (tap again to close)
GLO and EDIT follow the page: with one open, HOME flips it to its other half. The screen names the layer.
PLAY page (HOME unlit) - tap GLO - turn K1 to POLY+BR - tap GLO
PLAY page - tap GLO - turn K2 to FULL - tap GLO
HOME to SOUND (lit) - tap GLO (MORE) - turn K1 (PHONES MAX)
A Diosynth on the USB port
GLO - turn SELECT right (left: back to the computer)
PLAY page - K3 SCALE to MINOR - K1 QUANT to FULL (or EDIT, K4 BANK to SCALE) - the 1st, 4th, 5th white keys
press the M7 and S4 black keys together (they latch together)
tap SEL - K1 to K4 the digits (2741 C major, 1723 PCO) - SAVE keeps it in your list
tap SEQ, SELECT to 3, tap SEQ - play - tap REC (held: the whole history) - SAVE
tap SEQ - K2 LOOP ON - tap SEQ - PLAY - tap REC: a layer at the next pass; hold REC: undo
tap ARP - K2 RATE to 1/16 - SELECT, K2 LATCH ON - PLAY (the ARP on) - tap ARP
PRESETS to CLAV - HOME to SOUND - tap EDIT - SELECT to page 3/3 - K3 LEVEL down 6 steps - SAVE - tap EDIT
